title: How to Enable the Recurring Events
text:
## How to Enable the Recurring Events
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000050725

## Overview
Want to publish events that repeat daily or weekly? A recurring event is any event that occurs more than once, according to a specified time interval, such as meetings, courses and more.
The Auto-Recurring Events add-on eliminates the need to manually repost events that repeat – simply set how often the event should repeat and the website will automatically do the rest, creating recurring events!
Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club
Purchase Individually: Auto-Recurring Events Add-On

## Enabling Recurring Events
The events form will add these new fields for the events feature:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12059686865/original/Oy0S6JGaiIUhJEk_dNHQl1MbkafxRtedQg.png?1573748194 | alt: ]

## Recurring Event Options
Repeat Every Day
Repeat Every 7 Days (Weekly)
Repeat Every 14 Days (every 2 weeks)
Repeat Every 21 Days (every 3 weeks)
Repeat every 28 Days (every 4 weeks)
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12106414612/original/DBfRfZfddBMxq4KY7AvmflVl21dTSjzSBA.png?1647473446 | alt: ]

## Disable Recurring Events
If this add-on is not required in the directory, please follow these steps to turn off for the directory members:
1. Go to Content - Edit Post Settings
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12091993575/original/YhS6ZO164a2slPi2RG85D1H6_eBxxd-4mg.png?1619713094 | alt: ]
2.  Search for the default or any other event related feature and click Edit:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12091993753/original/7BnQUq9N4QWZXdq0vzOM5qboQZlpgKhLmQ.png?1619713328 | alt: ]
3. Scroll down in the General Settings and expand the Additional Settings:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12091993989/original/U8WxEEkbEukgZDg1Bu42AIEsrY90xyC7Bg.png?1619713724 | alt: ]
4. Enable or disable this feature:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12091994077/original/gPXMxICQCDSW0C6hovjV692Y1KC-f2Tk8g.png?1619713821 | alt: ]
